title: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash Makes 15-Second AI Videos
dek: Longer clips, steadier characters and a lower price for AI video.

facts.label: Max native clip, up from 10 seconds

caption:
A full 15-second AI video ad now costs about $1.05 to generate. 🎬

Google just released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, an updated AI video model that creates and edits clips up to 15 seconds long, up from 10. It keeps faces, clothing, packaging text and brand colors more consistent across camera angles, and it's 30% cheaper than Omni 1.1 at $0.07 per second for 720p.

The big new trick is chat-style editing: swap a product, change the background, lighting or weather, or switch the aspect ratio without starting over. It's now generally available in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Google Cloud, Google Vids, Flow and Gemini for business, with an invisible SynthID watermark on every output.

Google admits fast sports action and complex physics are still hard. But for marketers and creators making social ads and product demos, this is a real upgrade. We're tracking every AI video release at AI Parabellum.
